title: Day Seven: The First Hand (Ngày 7: Bàn tay đầu tiên)
location: Bình minh trong vắt sau lũ: thung lũng ngập bùn, cây đổ ngổn ngang. Hang dưới đã rút nước, vách đá ướt và vẫn trơn. Một phiến đá dùng để nghiền đất son đỏ.
axis: Máy quay đặt trong lòng hang dưới nhìn ra cửa hang sáng: vách đá trơn ẩm ở bên trái, nhũ đá hình con voi ở giữa hậu cảnh, phiến đá nghiền son ở bên phải, cửa hang rộng ngập nắng sớm ở xa nhất; riêng 19.1 máy đứng trên mỏm hang trên, sau lưng cả hang, nhìn xuống thung lũng bùn phía trước.
props: Phiến đá nghiền dẹt với bột son đỏ, vỏ ốc to đựng nước, ống sậy rỗng, ống tre giữ lửa của Grandma Moon, đai đeo ngực trống không camera của Khang, bàn tay son đỏ đầu tiên ở giữa vách.
setting: The lower Stone Age cave the morning after the flood: wet mud on the floor, the elephant-shaped stalactite, the bare damp rock wall in soft daylight, a flat grinding stone with red-ochre powder and a hollow reed tube.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Seventh sun. You lived, and you saved the cave.
turns.tone: slow and grave, like a law spoken aloud

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Not alone. Stream fed me, Roar held the rope, Snail kept the fire.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Then you are of the cave. We never walk alone.
turns.tone: warm and final, a rare small smile

clips.sfx: dawn birdsong across the valley, water dripping off the cliff, a soft wind on the ledge, the stream trickling far below, bare feet shifting on stone

shots.camera: 24mm wide shot along the cliff ledge over the mud-covered valley, the old woman in the foreground turning to camera, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the survivalist in the low dawn sun, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the survivalist onto the old woman, locked off
35mm medium two-shot in profile at the ledge edge, the misty valley glowing below, slow drift

steps: On the sunlit ledge above the mud-covered valley, @Moon turns from the edge toward @Khang, the bamboo ember tube in her arms, and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps speaking, each word weighed, the dawn sun lighting the deep lines of her face and the red dot on her forehead.
@Moon lifts her chin toward the drowned valley behind her as she goes on, while @Khang listens with his mouth closed.
@Moon keeps talking slowly, her calm eyes resting on the empty chest harness strapped over his torn shirt.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth; @Khang shakes his head with a tired smile, draws a breath and starts answering.
@Khang keeps talking warmly, his stubble grown into a short dark beard, counting names on the fingers of one blistered hand.
@Khang keeps speaking, tipping his head toward the clan standing along the ledge behind him.
@Khang goes on, his voice catching slightly, his eyes shining in the low gold light.
@Khang keeps talking, pressing one blistered palm flat against his chest over the empty harness.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, looking down at his muddy boots, while @Moon draws a breath beside him.
@Moon steps closer, lays one small wrinkled hand on his forearm and answers, her low voice softening.
@Moon keeps speaking, holding his gaze, the bamboo ember tube tucked against her hide cloak.
@Moon keeps going, nodding once toward the clan along the ledge as she says the last words.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, a rare small smile creasing her lined face.
@Khang bows his head to her, mouth closed, while mist curls off the drowned valley below them in the dawn sun.
clips.extras: a dozen clan members in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps stand along the ledge looking down at the valley, seen from behind in soft focus
clips._hinh: Cả hang (quần chúng) đứng trên mỏm đá nhìn xuống thung lũng tan hoang. Grandma Moon quay lại nhìn Khang, nắng sớm trên mặt bà.
clips.setting: Clear golden dawn after the flood, seen from a ledge-cave high on the limestone cliff: the valley below covered in mud and fallen trees, the stream back in its bed, mist rising off the jungle.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: From today, whoever saves the cave leaves a hand on the wall.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Red earth and water, blown through a reed. Fire first?
turns.tone: curious and eager, turning the reed

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Yes. His hand is biggest. Put it in the middle.

clips.sfx: stone grinding on stone, water dripping from the cave roof, runoff trickling across the mud floor, birdsong outside the bright mouth

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the old woman kneeling at the flat grinding stone beside the bare wet wall, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the young forager holding a hollow reed, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the young forager onto the old woman, locked off

steps: In the damp lower cave, @Moon kneels at a flat grinding stone, rolling a pebble through red-ochre powder, and is already speaking in a steady voice.
@Moon keeps speaking as she tips water from a large snail shell onto the powder, turning it into a red paste.
@Moon keeps going, lifting her red-stained fingers toward the bare wet wall beside her.
@Moon keeps talking, her eyes moving slowly across the empty rock, while @Stream watches with her mouth closed.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, wiping her red fingertips on the edge of the grinding stone.
@Stream steps in holding a hollow reed tube, tilts her head and starts speaking eagerly.
@Stream keeps talking, turning the hollow reed between her fingers and peering through it at the daylight.
@Stream keeps speaking, glancing from the red paste to the bare wall with bright eyes.
@Stream asks her last question with her eyebrows raised, then closes her mouth and waits.
@Moon looks up at her and answers slowly, setting the pebble down on the grinding stone.
@Moon keeps speaking, holding up one wrinkled hand and spreading the fingers wide.
@Moon keeps going slowly, pointing one red-stained finger at the very middle of the bare wall.
@Moon keeps talking as both women turn their faces toward the empty rock in the soft daylight.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth, nodding once, while @Stream breathes in and grips the reed tighter.
@Stream carries a small shell cup of red paste toward the wall, mouth closed, while @Moon watches in silence.
clips._hinh: Trong hang dưới, Grandma Moon nghiền đất son đỏ trên phiến đá, trộn nước. Stream cầm một ống sậy rỗng, nhìn lên vách trơn.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: The big hand in the middle... it's mine. Always was.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: What's wrong, Fire? No rain will ever wash it away.
turns.tone: gentle, puzzled, proud of her work

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: No. Ten thousand years from now, some idiot will fit his hand in it.

clips.sfx: soft puffs of air through a hollow reed, a fine spray hissing on wet stone, water dripping in the cave, morning birdsong outside

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot at the bare wall, his palm flat in the middle of the rock as she puffs red mist through a reed, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the young forager lowering the reed, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the young forager onto the survivalist and the fresh red hand, locked off
35mm medium two-shot at the wall, the fresh red hand between them, slow push-in

steps: At the bare wall, @Khang holds his palm flat in the middle of the rock while @Stream puffs red mist around his fingers, and he is already whispering.
@Khang keeps whispering, staring at the red outline forming around his spread fingers on the wet stone.
@Khang keeps whispering, his breath shaking, while @Stream moves the reed slowly along his thumb in soft red puffs.
@Khang goes on in a hushed voice, his eyes wide and wet above his short beard, never leaving his own hand.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and slowly peels his palm off the rock, leaving a bright red hand outline, as @Stream lowers the reed.
@Stream asks gently, red dust on her lips, searching his face with her bright dark eyes.
@Stream keeps speaking, nodding at the red hand on the wall with a small proud smile.
@Stream goes on warmly, touching the dry rock just beside the stencil with one fingertip.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, waiting, while @Khang stares at the wall, his jaw trembling.
@Khang lets out a shaky laugh, tears brimming, and starts answering, his voice cracking.
@Khang keeps talking, wiping his eyes with the back of his wrist, laughing and crying at once.
@Khang keeps speaking, holding up his red-dusted palm beside the red hand on the wall.
@Khang goes on, shaking his head at himself, tears running down into his beard.
@Khang finishes the last words with a broken grin, his eyes on the stencil.
@Khang closes his mouth and breathes out shakily beside the fresh red hand, while @Stream watches him in silence.
clips._hinh: Khang áp bàn tay lên giữa vách; Stream ngậm màu, thổi qua ống sậy quanh bàn tay. Khang rút tay ra: một bàn tay đỏ tươi in âm bản, đúng vị trí, đúng hình bàn tay to giữa vách ở cảnh 3. Khang sững người.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: My hand next to yours. So everyone knows they went together.
turns.tone: soft and shy, eyes on the wall

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Stream... if I have to leave, will you be angry?

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: A stream goes far but marks the stone. If you go, your hand stays.

clips.sfx: soft puffs of air through a reed, a fine spray hissing on stone, water dripping in the cave, morning birdsong outside, a slow breath

shots.camera: 35mm medium two-shot at the wall, holding the previous framing, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the survivalist turning to her, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the survivalist onto the young forager at the wall
85mm close-up of the young forager in profile, the two red hands sharp on the wall beyond her, locked off

steps: @Stream steps up beside @Khang, presses her small hand flat on the rock right next to his red stencil, and is already speaking softly.
@Stream keeps talking, spreading her fingers wide on the damp stone, her eyes on the two hands.
@Stream keeps speaking, a shy smile tugging at her mouth, while @Khang watches her with his mouth closed.
@Stream goes on, lifting the hollow reed toward her chin with her free hand.
@Stream finishes and closes her mouth, puts the reed to her lips, and @Khang turns toward her, swallowing.
@Khang asks slowly and quietly, his eyes on her face, while soft red mist puffs out of focus beside him.
@Khang keeps speaking haltingly, his voice low, his bearded jaw tight, his eyes never leaving her.
@Khang goes on, glancing toward the daylight at the cave mouth and back to her.
@Khang finishes his question, closes his mouth and waits, breathing slowly, the empty harness rising and falling on his chest.
@Stream lowers the reed and peels her hand off the rock, two red hands now side by side, and answers without looking at him.
@Stream keeps speaking, her eyes fixed on the wall, red dust on her fingertips.
@Stream keeps talking evenly, touching the edge of her own red hand with one finger.
@Stream goes on, her chin lifting, blinking fast, still not looking at him.
@Stream keeps speaking steadily, a single tear sliding down past the red stripes on her cheek.
@Stream finishes the last words and closes her mouth, gazing at the two red hands side by side, while @Khang watches her in silence.
clips._hinh: Stream áp bàn tay mình ngay sát bàn tay đỏ của Khang; Grandma Moon (cảnh quay riêng) thổi son quanh. Hai bàn tay đỏ nằm cạnh nhau. Khang nhìn Stream, Stream nhìn vách.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

title: Snail's Seeing Stone (Hòn đá có mắt của Snail)
location: Bãi suối sau lũ đã trong lại, nắng trưa; trong hang dưới, vách có hai bàn tay đỏ; chiều xuống, mây giông kéo về đầu núi.
axis: Máy quay đứng trên bãi sỏi nhìn ngược dòng: suối trong ở bên trái, tảng đá Khang ngồi ở giữa, bó cỏ làm bia ở xa bên phải, vách đá vôi và rừng ở hậu cảnh; 20.3 quay sát vách hang có hai bàn tay đỏ ở bên trái và bếp lửa bên phải, 20.4 đứng ở cửa hang nhìn ra núi với vách có hai bàn tay ở bên trái.
props: Phiến đá dẹt có lỗ thủng của Snail, giáo tre mũi đá, bó cỏ làm bia, cái lờ tre Roar đan dở, gậy chống và nẹp chân quấn khăn rằn đỏ của Roar, cục than, hai bàn tay son đỏ trên vách.
setting: The jungle stream in the Stone Age at midday after the flood: the water clear again, a gravel bar with drying driftwood, a bundle of grass set up as a target, children of the clan playing on the stones.

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: Hello everyone! Fire, fish, boiled water! I can survive anywhere!
turns.tone: bursting with excitement, a tiny showman

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: Who taught you that? That line was a lie for three years.

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: You say it to your stone every morning! Now I have one!

clips.sfx: the clear stream rippling over stones, small bare feet splashing in the shallows, cicadas in the midday heat, driftwood creaking in the sun

shots.camera: 35mm medium shot of the boy on a river stone holding a flat holed stone up like a camera, handheld follow
85mm close-up of the survivalist on a boulder, laughing, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the survivalist onto the boy and the children
24mm wide shot of the sunny gravel bar and the clear stream, slow pull-back

steps: On a sunny river stone, @Snail holds a flat stone with a hole in it up to his face like a camera and is already shouting excitedly into it.
@Snail keeps talking fast, swinging the stone toward the clear stream and back to his own grinning face.
@Snail keeps going, flexing one skinny arm for the stone, while the children around him bounce on their heels.
@Snail finishes with a big proud grin and closes his mouth; on a boulder nearby, @Khang bursts out laughing and starts to answer.
@Khang laughs and asks, shaking his head, his muddy elbows propped on his knees.
@Khang keeps talking, wiping a tear of laughter from his eye with his wrist.
@Khang goes on, his grin softening into something rueful, pointing at the boy.
@Khang keeps speaking, tapping the empty chest harness on his torn shirt with two fingers.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, still smiling, as @Snail spins around to face him.
@Snail answers fast, jabbing the flat stone toward @Khang, his big eyes shining.
@Snail keeps talking quickly, holding the stone up proudly to show off the hole.
@Snail keeps going, pressing one eye to the hole as if filming @Khang.
@Snail finishes, closes his mouth and grins through the hole in the stone.
@Khang shakes with silent laughter, lips pressed together, and raises both hands in surrender as the children crowd closer.
@Snail turns the stone toward the children on the gravel bar, mouth closed, while @Khang watches him fondly from the boulder.
clips.extras: a few small clan children in knee-length bark-cloth tunics crouch on the river stones around the boy, grinning, in soft focus
clips._hinh: Snail giơ một phiến đá dẹt có lỗ thủng ngang mặt như cầm camera, nói vào nó như Khang vẫn làm; lũ trẻ (quần chúng) xúm quanh. Khang ngồi trên tảng đá bật cười.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Eyes closed, you only hit sky. Eyes open, see the target, let go.
turns.tone: gruff and teasing, laughing for once

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: You learned traps in one morning. I still can't hit anything!

turns.speaker: @Roar
turns.line: Your hands make fire and traps. Leave the spear to me, brother.

clips.sfx: a bamboo spear skidding across gravel, the stream rippling, split rattan creaking in big hands, cicadas, a breeze rustling the reeds

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the hunter seated on a flat rock with a half-woven fish trap, slow push-in
24mm wide shot across the empty gravel bar, the survivalist in profile and the grass bundle far right, locked off
85mm close-up of the survivalist, sweaty and grinning ruefully, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the survivalist onto the hunter, slow push-in

steps: On the sunny gravel bar, @Roar sits on a flat rock with his splinted ankle stretched out, weaving a fish trap, and is already speaking with a gruff grin.
@Roar keeps talking, squeezing his eyes shut in mockery and flapping one big hand at the sky.
@Roar opens his eyes wide and keeps speaking, pointing two fingers from his eyes toward the grass bundle downstream.
@Roar keeps going, miming a slow release with his open hand, while @Khang lifts the bamboo spear upright beside him, mouth closed.
@Roar says the last words as @Khang walks out onto the empty gravel, sets his feet and raises the spear toward the grass bundle.
@Roar closes his mouth as @Khang sends the spear arcing toward the grass bundle; it skids into the gravel far wide of it, and he starts complaining fast.
@Khang keeps talking fast, both palms up at the untouched grass bundle, sweat running into his short beard.
@Khang keeps going, pointing at the neat half-woven fish trap on @Roar's lap, his eyebrows high.
@Khang keeps talking, shaking his head at his own blistered palms with a crooked laugh.
@Khang finishes, closes his mouth and drops to sit on the gravel beside @Roar's rock, as @Roar starts answering.
@Roar keeps speaking in his deep voice, tapping @Khang's blistered palm with one thick finger.
@Roar keeps talking, lifting the half-woven fish trap and turning it in the sun.
@Roar goes on, laying one heavy hand on @Khang's shoulder, his fierce eyes softening.
@Roar keeps speaking, leaning closer, his gruff voice dropping warm on the final word.
@Roar closes his mouth and a slow wide grin breaks across his fierce face, his shoulders shaking with a silent laugh.
clips._hinh: Roar ngồi (chân còn nẹp) đan một cái lờ đẹp hơn cái của Khang, mấy cậu trai ngồi học. Khang tập phóng giáo vào một bó cỏ, trượt xa. Roar cười, lần đầu tiên.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera
wardrobe.@Roar: a sleeveless vest of dark boar hide that fully covers his chest, a knee-length bark-cloth kilt, a necklace of curved boar tusks, his left ankle splinted between two straight sticks bound with a red bandana, leaning on a wooden staff, barefoot

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: What's this? Why's he wearing a box on his chest?

turns.speaker: @Snail
turns.line: It's you and your seeing stone. The water took it. I drew it so it's not sad.

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: It's beautiful. Best picture I've ever had.

clips.sfx: charcoal scratching on rock, the hearth fire crackling, water dripping from the stalactite, the stream murmuring outside the cave

steps: By the firelit wall with the two red hands, @Khang crouches beside @Snail, who is scratching charcoal lines on the rock, and is already asking with a curious smile.
@Khang keeps speaking, tilting his head at the charcoal stick figure taking shape beside the red hands.
@Khang keeps going, tapping his own chest where the camera used to sit in the empty harness.
@Khang finishes his question and closes his mouth, eyebrows raised, while @Snail adds a square to the figure's chest.
@Snail keeps drawing and starts answering in a careful, focused voice without looking up.
@Snail keeps talking, adding short rays around the square with quick charcoal strokes.
@Snail keeps speaking, his eyes intent on the wall, black dust on his small fingers.
@Snail goes on, his voice dropping a little, the charcoal pausing over the rock.
@Snail keeps talking, turning to look up at @Khang with big serious eyes.
@Snail keeps speaking earnestly, pointing the charcoal at the little box on the figure's chest.
@Snail finishes and closes his mouth, waiting for a verdict, while @Khang stares at the drawing.
@Khang swallows hard and answers slowly, his voice thick, his eyes shining in the firelight.
@Khang keeps speaking softly, laying one hand gently on @Snail's shaved head.
@Khang finishes the last words almost in a whisper and closes his mouth.
@Khang breathes out and smiles, mouth closed, his eyes wet in the flickering firelight.
clips._hinh: Trong hang dưới, Snail cầm cục than vẽ lên vách cạnh hai bàn tay đỏ: một người que, trên ngực có hình vuông với những tia sáng toả ra. Khang ngồi xuống cạnh cậu bé.
clips.setting: The lower Stone Age cave on the seventh day: the elephant-shaped stalactite and, on the rock wall, two fresh red-ochre hand stencils side by side, a big hand and a slightly smaller hand, with bare rock around them; a hearth fire burning.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Thunder again. Like the night you came.
turns.tone: slow and grave, listening to the sky

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: You feel it too? Since noon, the wall has been getting warmer.

turns.speaker: @Moon
turns.line: Thunder brought you. Thunder will call you home. The cave remembers its own.

clips.sfx: distant rolling thunder, wind rushing through the jungle canopy, the hearth fire crackling behind, the first fat raindrops on broad leaves

steps: At the cave mouth, @Moon stands beside @Khang watching black storm clouds roll over the karst peaks, and is already speaking slowly.
@Moon keeps speaking, her white hair stirring in the rising wind, a far flicker of lightning behind the peaks.
@Moon goes on, her calm eyes narrowing at the clouds, the bamboo ember tube held against her cloak.
@Moon finishes and closes her mouth; @Khang turns from the storm and reaches toward the inner rock wall.
@Khang lays his palm flat on the rock beside the two red hands and starts speaking, his eyes narrowing.
@Khang keeps talking, pressing harder, then jerks his hand back off the stone.
@Khang keeps speaking, staring down into his open palm, rubbing his fingertips together.
@Khang goes on, lifting his warm palm toward @Moon, his breath quickening.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, looking at @Moon, as she turns her face to him.
@Moon answers slowly, laying her own wrinkled hand on the wall beside his red stencil.
@Moon keeps speaking, her voice low and certain, as thunder rolls over the peaks outside.
@Moon goes on, turning her eyes to the dark clouds beyond the cave mouth.
@Moon keeps speaking slowly, lightning flickering across the deep lines of her face.
@Moon says the last words softly, her eyes resting on his face, then closes her mouth.
@Moon stands in silence, mouth closed, the wind tugging at her hide cloak as she looks at him.
clips._hinh: Chiều, sấm rền xa, mây đen kéo về đầu núi. Grandma Moon đứng cạnh Khang ở cửa hang. Khang chạm lên vách rồi rụt tay lại, nhìn lòng bàn tay.
clips.setting: Late afternoon at the mouth of the Stone Age clan cave: black storm clouds rolling over the karst peaks, distant thunder, wind in the jungle, warm firelight behind, and on the inner wall two red-ochre hand stencils.

wardrobe.@Khang: dirty torn olive-green tactical shirt with rolled sleeves, muddy khaki cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, an empty black chest harness with no camera

title: Storm on the Seventh Evening (Giông chiều thứ bảy)
location: Hang Bàn Tay trong giông: chớp hắt trắng lên vách có hai bàn tay đỏ và hình vẽ than; bếp lửa giữa hang chập chờn; cả hang (quần chúng) đứng lùi lại.
axis: Máy quay đặt trong hang dưới: vách có hai bàn tay đỏ và hình người que bằng than ở bên trái, nhũ đá hình con voi ở giữa hậu cảnh, bếp lửa và cả hang đứng lùi trong bóng tối ở bên phải, cửa hang rộng loé chớp trắng ở xa nhất.
props: Hai bàn tay son đỏ và hình người que đeo hộp vuông bằng than trên vách, chuỗi vỏ ốc suối của Stream, giỏ mây, hòn đá dẹt có lỗ của Snail, bếp lửa chập chờn, đai đeo ngực trống không của Khang.
setting: A storm at night inside the lower Stone Age cave: white lightning flashing through the wide mouth onto the rock wall with two red-ochre hand stencils side by side and a small charcoal stick figure, the elephant-shaped stalactite, a flickering hearth fire, the clan standing back in the shadows.

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Are you really leaving, Fire? Here there's fire, fish, me. Not enough?
turns.tone: slow and hurt, voice barely steady

turns.speaker: @Khang
turns.line: More than enough. More than anywhere I've lived. But my mom is waiting, and my friend is searching.
turns.tone: turning to her, gentle and torn

turns.speaker: @Stream
turns.line: Then you must go.

clips.sfx: rolling thunder, rain roaring beyond the cave mouth, wind gusting through the entrance, the hearth fire hissing and crackling

title: Return (Trở về)

title: Fire-Maker (Người làm ra lửa)
time_label: Sáng, hang Bàn Tay ngày nay và hơn một vạn năm trước (23:00–24:00)
location: Hang Bàn Tay hôm nay, nắng sớm rọi xiên vào cửa hang. Clip cuối cắt song song với cùng hang ấy hơn một vạn năm trước, bên bếp lửa.
axis: Máy quay đặt trong lòng hang nhìn ra cửa hang ngập nắng: vách hàng trăm bàn tay đỏ mờ ở bên trái với bàn tay to ở giữa, bàn tay nhỏ và hình người que bằng than sát bên, nhũ đá hình con voi ở giữa hậu cảnh, cửa hang vòm rộng ở xa bên phải; riêng 24.4 cắt song song cùng góc máy ấy giữa buổi sáng hôm nay và đêm bên bếp lửa hơn một vạn năm trước.
props: Đèn pin và điện thoại của Bin (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), chuỗi vỏ ốc suối trên cổ Khang, hai bàn tay son đỏ và hình người que đeo hộp vuông bằng than trên vách; ở thời xưa: hòn đá dẹt có lỗ của Snail, bếp lửa, ống tre chẻ đôi và thanh tre cưa lửa.
setting: Morning inside the same large limestone cave today: sunlight slanting through the wide arched mouth onto the elephant-shaped stalactite and the wall of hundreds of faded red-ochre hand stencils, the bigger hand in the middle with a smaller hand beside it and a faint charcoal stick figure wearing a square box on its chest.

turns.line: A little boy drew it. So the seeing stone wouldn't be sad.

turns.speaker: @Bin
turns.line: Archaeologists say it's over ten thousand years old!

@Bin keeps talking excitedly, stepping closer to the big faded hand in the middle of the wall.

@Bin keeps talking fast, tracing in the air the little square box with rays on the figure's chest.
@Bin keeps going, tapping his own chest where a camera harness would sit, his eyes wide behind his glasses.
@Bin finishes and closes his mouth, turning to @Khang with his eyebrows shooting up, lips pressed together.
@Khang steps up beside him, gazing at the charcoal figure, and answers slowly with a soft smile.
@Khang keeps speaking gently, touching the stream-snail shells at his collar, his eyes on the drawing.
@Khang goes on, his eyes warm and wet in the slanting sunlight.
@Khang keeps speaking softly, nodding at the little drawing as if greeting an old friend.
@Khang finishes and closes his mouth, still smiling at the faint charcoal figure on the wall.

steps: In the sunlit mouth of the cave today, @Khang faces a phone held up by an unseen hand and is already speaking slowly and plainly.
@Khang keeps speaking, today's morning light on his face, the green limestone jungle bright behind him.
@Khang goes on quietly, his eyes steady on the phone, with no showman's grin.
@Khang keeps speaking, lifting one hand to rest his fingers on the stream-snail shells at his collar.
@Khang keeps talking slowly, rolling one small shell between his fingers, his eyes shining.
@Khang goes on, glancing back over his shoulder toward the faded wall of red hands deep in today's cave.
@Khang keeps speaking, his voice catching slightly, a small grateful smile forming.
@Khang finishes the last words and closes his mouth, breathing out, the sun warm on his face.
More than ten thousand years ago at night, @Snail stands by the hearth fire, raises his flat stone with a hole to his face and starts shouting brightly.
Long ago at night, @Snail keeps talking fast, beaming, pointing the flat stone at the clan seated around the fire.
Long ago by the hearth, @Snail keeps going, lifting a split bamboo tube and a notched bamboo strip from the ground.
Long ago at night, @Snail keeps shouting with joy, sawing the strip across the bamboo once to show the seated clan.
Long ago by the firelight, @Snail keeps talking, thrusting the flat stone high, his snail-shell bracelet rattling on his wrist.
Long ago at night, firelight flickers over the two fresh red hands side by side on the rock wall, one big and one smaller, as the boy falls silent.
Today, soft morning sunlight replaces the firelight on the very same two hands, now faded with age, still side by side.
clips.extras: in the night shots long ago only, the Stone Age clan in bark-cloth tunics and hide wraps sits around the hearth watching the boy, in soft focus
clips._hinh: Cắt song song. Hôm nay: Khang đứng ở cửa hang ngập nắng, nói vào điện thoại Bin đang quay, tay chạm chuỗi vỏ ốc. Hơn một vạn năm trước: Snail đứng bên bếp lửa, giơ hòn đá dẹt có lỗ, trước mặt là cả hang ngồi xem, phía sau là ống tre và thanh tre cưa lửa. Hình cuối: hai bàn tay đỏ tươi trên vách, rồi chuyển sang chính hai bàn tay ấy đã mờ ở hiện tại.
